name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Government-backed savings scheme targeted at parents of girl children to build a fund for future education and marriage.
benefits: Highest sovereign-backed interest rate (8.2%+), full tax exemption under 80C, guaranteed corpus

criteria.description: Beneficiary must be a female / girl child
criteria.disqualification_reason: Sukanya Samriddhi is exclusively for female children

criteria.description: Account must be opened before girl child turns 10 years old
criteria.disqualification_reason: Age exceeds 10 years maximum opening age
